housing: Help with rent, eviction-related housing costs or rental deposits; individual program rules and available funds differ.
Individual housing assessment, coordinated entry or practical help accessing housing programs; not a guarantee of placement.
Short-term emergency shelter or a named shelter admission pathway.
Below-market rental housing with program-specific income and availability rules.
Rental subsidy or housing voucher application and administration.
Recovery-oriented sober housing; distinguish from licensed residential clinical treatment.
Residential housing available as part of a clinical treatment program with admission and payer requirements.
Time-limited housing with a transition or stabilization program.
Housing combined with ongoing case management or support services.
Disability or older-adult community living arrangements and support; not general affordable rental housing.
Time-limited assistance to move from homelessness into housing with stabilization support.
Legal advice, negotiation or representation for housing or eviction problems; referral and representation limits vary.
food: Meals ready to eat through community, institutional or program-specific access.
Food purchasing/nutrition benefits or practical assistance applying for those benefits.
An explicitly documented route to infant formula; not inferred from general food boxes.
Groceries or food boxes through a pantry or distribution, with any boundaries and access limits in the resource.

Food or meals accessed through school, campus or student-specific programs.

Bus passes, reduced fares or ride vouchers; mode, eligibility and available funding remain in the service details.
Transportation restricted to participants of another named service or residential program.
Volunteer-arranged trips with advance booking, geography and driver-capacity limits.
Instruction and practical support learning to use transportation independently.
Provision or repair of bicycles for personal transportation.
Accessible paratransit requiring its specific eligibility assessment and reservation process.
Shared or organized commuting options distinct from medical and crisis rides.
id-recovery: Replacement or correction of immigration-related identity/status documents, or qualified legal help obtaining them.
Practical individual help obtaining identity documents or navigating issuing agencies.
Application, replacement or specifically documented assistance obtaining state identification or a driver license.
Issuance or specifically documented assistance obtaining a birth certificate.
A specifically documented service keeping important documents safe.
A mailing or document-receipt service for people who need a reliable address.
Replacement cards or specifically documented assistance with the replacement process.
Tribal identification or enrollment credentials with community-specific eligibility.
Obtaining, recording or replacing military service/discharge records.

taxonomyJudgment: Consolidate equivalent access facets, not every uncommon concept: rent/deposit/eviction cost aid, navigation/coordinated entry, food-benefit navigation, and fare support share useful broader filters. Keep clinical versus recovery housing, vouchers versus affordable rentals, and rare high-value formula, paratransit, tribal-ID and document-storage routes separate. The reviewed 22 population/access groups distinguish materially different eligibility or support needs; retain their definitions and evidence rather than merging by frequency alone. Spanish is an evidenced language-access feature, not inferred ethnicity. No group assignment means no specific evidenced group, never that every person qualifies.
populationPolicy: For this migration, reuse the reviewed Eligibility Requirements paragraph as Population Served when no separately reviewed population prose exists. It conservatively preserves exact restrictions without inferring broader eligibility from a label. This temporary repetition is intentional; new preparation workers write distinct evidence-backed sections.
preservationJudgment: Use the reviewed seed plus saved browser overrides. Carry forward all text and sources when consolidating the three explicit identities. Preserve suppressed records in the identity migration and audit without exporting them for missionary use. Remove only specifically unsupported memberships in this four-category projection. All original records, other categories and prior decisions remain unchanged in Scout. Starter selection is Michael's accepted trial, never office Curated approval.
